text_block_list.text: One day off—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy! Warm, sunny sunshine! A perfect day 
for hiking!
choice_data_list: I'm really looking forward to it!
I'm really looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ Today, I came up with a plan that 
pays homage to a route I once walked with 
my family!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
A course full of thrills and excitement! 
Let's enjoy it together~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Phew~~~... We reached the halfway mark in 
no time! Japanese mountains are so mini 
and cute, *desu*♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Trainer-san, are you okay!? You're 
completely out of breath!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Still, you're super unsteady—ah!
(Smack!)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That was close! Hand, catch! It 
would be terrible if you fell in a place 
like this, yes.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! It feels like the roles are reversed 
today. I'm honored to have been of help!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to rely on me waaaay more, 
so... I shall escort you all the way to 
the high ground, yes♪"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Let's lunch tiiiime! When you think of a 
classic hiking lunch—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—That's it! A special club sandwich bigger 
than your face! Time to dig in and GO!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Common knowledge in my family! Just 
one will fill your belly right up!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fresh tomatoes! Cheese! Meat!! And for the 
drink, a giant mug of milk!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hearty and satisfying, goes down smooth♪ 
Now! Go ahead and take a big bite!
choice_data_list:
It's so huge, how are we supposed to eat 
it?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Then let me feed you! My mama used to do 
this for me long ago♪
choice_data_list: I-I can eat on my own!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~! Panicking like that... Trainer, 
you're blushing!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~! So cute~! My heart is pounding, I'm 
full of excitement, desu!

My heart was racing the entire time, but 
we finished our meal, and the next place 
she led me to was...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
For the grand finale... we fly away in a 
hot air balloon!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
There are so many hot air balloons flying! 
Look! So, so many... So many—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: She can jump THAT high?! No way-desu ka?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ha! Come to think of it, Daddy... always 
carried me in his arms whenever I rode 
it...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
B-But... I'm a grown lady now! Something 
like this is no problem at all~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...B-But if you're scared, Trainer, we 
can always do something else...!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: O... ...Okay! Okay!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? It's so high after all, desu! I'm 
scared! Trainer-saa~~n!!
(Squeeeeeeeze――!!)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh!? No way, no way...! I'll never 
let you goooo~~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Trainer-san is a lifesaver, YES! 
Thanks to you, I made it safely back to 
the ground!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Exaggeration, no! Because I held tight to 
you, Trainer, I was able to feel safe!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Besides... I'm so happy because I feel 
like my heart has drawn even closer to 
yours, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ha! ......I-If we ride it one more time, 
will our hearts stick together even 
more...!?

"No matter how many hearts I have, it 
wouldn't be enough at this rate. I 
hurriedly persuaded her... and we brought 
the hike to an end."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
O... Ohhh~~! That's wonderful-desu! Then 
let's do something else that isn't scary!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Boat! Boat! River cruising~♪ Let's paddle 
our oars as one!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oars at the ready... One-two, one-two! 
Pull even harder~! ...Ooonnne-twoooo!!
choice_data_list: W-Wait, if you rush into it like that—

text_block_list.text: (SPLAAASH!!)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! My legs are soaking wet~! We 
could totally play in the waterâ

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: —*sneeze*

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow...! Trainer, you're so cool and 
gentle...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I intended to shoot your heart, 
but it seems the tables have turned on 
me...♪

Heading back with a high-spirited Taiki 
Shuttle... the hiking trip came to an end.
